project.name: APSO_SIM_Thz
project.description: Simulation and optimization system for autonomous movable wireless transmitting nodes in THz band using hierarchical multi-tier swarm optimization under dynamic human density blockages.

invention.title: System and Method for Dynamic Spatial Repositioning, Orientation Adjustment, and Transmission Parameter Adaptation of Movable Wireless Communication Nodes Using Optimization-Driven Control Under Changing Environmental Conditions
invention.core_idea: Physically movable wireless nodes that autonomously reposition (X,Y,Z) and adjust electronic parameters (beamwidth, azimuth) in a hierarchical multi-tier framework — electronic tuning first, physical movement only when needed — driven by swarm optimization responsive to real-time environmental conditions.
key_novelties: Hierarchical multi-tier optimization: escalates from electronic-only to vertical to full spatial repositioning
Joint multi-node swarm optimization — all nodes optimized simultaneously as coordinated collective
Composite fitness function: coverage + density-weighted coverage + movement penalty + anti-clustering + target bonus
Dynamic human density integration via time-varying density matrix D(x,y,t)
Material-aware 3D propagation model with height-aware ray intersection
invention.generalization: Patent covers any wireless node type, any frequency band (sub-1GHz to optical), any optimization algorithm, any mobility mechanism (existing or future), any sensing modality, any environment, any coverage threshold (0.1%-100%)

tiers.tier_1_2: Electronic only: beamwidth + azimuth, positions locked
